UI_LXHP_desc: Split-screen and controller support for Heli Pack. Player 2 can finally fly, and the sticks give finer control than the keyboard ever could.
UI_LXHP_layout_tip: 1 = how a real helicopter works: left stick is collective (up/down) and pedals (turn), right stick is the cyclic (forward/back and sideways). 2 = what you expect coming from a car: left stick is forward/back and turn, right stick is up/down and sideways.
UI_LXHP_dead_tip: Sticks never rest at exactly zero. Below this the stick is ignored, and what is left is rescaled so the useful travel still runs from 0 to 1 instead of jumping. Raise it if your helicopter drifts on its own.
UI_LXHP_invert_tip: Push forward to descend, like a flight stick.
